title: I made a NES emulator in 15 minutes
summary: Bisqwit writes a NES emulator in C++ in about 15 minutes of tool-assisted, sped-up coding, narrated with captions. It shows an accurate emulator built with a compile-time generated 6502 instruction table. Part 2 covers compiling and running it.
why: HN programmers admire it as a clean, clever demonstration of emulator design and as the standout of a favorite programming YouTuber.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: Here's a very clean and clever NES emulator in C++ by Bisqwit of TAS fame
